prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 4 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 10 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: Sebastian's apartment, living room, Night, warm lamplight indoors, city lights glowing through the window.
Image 1: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 3: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location Sebastian's apartment, living room, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop agreement; use only structure, material, and color
Image 10: the prop bag; use only structure, material, and color
Image 11: the prop lace bra; use only structure, material, and color
Image 12: the prop pillow; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Natalie sits at the kitchenette end of the couch in her bridal gown, leaning over the round coffee table with the blue pen over the written agreement; her pale-blue bag stands on the floor at the kitchenette end of the couch. Sebastian, in his tuxedo, stands on the window side of the coffee table, facing her. The white pillow lies on the dining chair nearer the couch.
Panel 1: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie on the couch, eye-level on Sebastian. Sebastian holds up two fingers, then lowers his hand to the coffee table.
Panel 2: Close-up insert, high angle, on the agreement on the coffee table. Natalie's hand signs her name at the bottom of the handwritten agreement.
Panel 3: Medium shot, eye-level, both in profile across the coffee table. Sebastian takes the pen from Natalie, bends over the coffee table and signs beneath her name while she watches.
Panel 4: Medium shot, low angle, on Natalie at the kitchenette end of the couch. Natalie lifts her unfastened pale-blue bag from the floor and sets it on the coffee table, its top gaping open.
Panel 5: Close-up insert, high angle, on the coffee table. A folded pale-blush lace bra slips out of the open bag and lands on the signed agreement.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, eye-level, on Natalie leaning over the table. Natalie, cheeks flushing, quickly scoops the lace bra back into her bag.
Panel 7: Medium shot, locked-off, eye-level, on Sebastian across the coffee table. Sebastian raises one eyebrow with a slow, amused smile.
Panel 8: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Sebastian, eye-level on Natalie. Natalie clutches the bag shut against her and gives him a sharp look.
Panel 9: Medium shot, pan following Sebastian from the coffee table to the dining chair and back, eye-level. Sebastian picks up the white pillow from the dining chair nearer the couch and drops it onto the front-door end of the couch.
Panel 10: Wide shot, locked-off, eye-level, from the kitchenette side; bedroom door at frame right. Natalie rises with her bag and walks into the bedroom, leaving the door half closed behind her. Sebastian now stands at the kitchenette end of the couch, watching the door. The signed agreement and the pen stay on the coffee table.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
